description:
Fourteen committed benchmark receipts are rejected when their acceptance is re-evaluated on a fresh checkout, although the acceptance summaries committed beside them record them as accepted.

## Background

The acceptance tool (`benchmark-acceptance` in `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support`) evaluates a receipt against the producing-input snapshot stored in the receipt directory. Nested `Cargo.lock` files are excluded by `.gitignore`, so several snapshots were committed without a lockfile their receipt pins, and the committed acceptance summaries were written where the files still existed. A comparison that built the evaluator from two revisions and ran both over every committed receipt on a fresh checkout (`dev/active/bdc507a3/verdict-preservation.json`, `committed_verdict_differs_from_both`) found these receipts rejected by both builds:

- `dev/bench_results/04b85d10/2026-09-08-04b85d10-consumers-pilot/`
- `dev/bench_results/1d0da41f/2026-09-08-1d0da41f-clmul-dispatch-confirmation/`, `v3-confirmation/`, `v3-pilot/`, `v3-pilot-r2/`
- `dev/bench_results/26465e6c/2026-09-07-26465e6c-popcount-pilot/`
- `dev/bench_results/6fb89a3c/2026-09-08-6fb89a3c-bch-pilot/`, `-logical-pilot/`, `-transpose-pilot/`
- `dev/bench_results/c077a88b/2026-09-08-r3-c077a88b-ldpc-matched-algorithm-pilot/`, `-r3-…-quality-compatible-pilot/`, `-r4-…-matched-algorithm-pilot/`, `-r4-…-quality-compatible-pilot/`
- `dev/bench_results/f547c394/v3-confirmation/`

Most lack a snapshot `Cargo.lock`; the 1d0da41f v1 dispatch confirmation fails P-23. Some of these receipts are governing evidence of closed issues, so claims resting on them do not currently reproduce from the repository.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: For each listed receipt, the cause of the fresh-checkout rejection is identified and recorded, and the receipt either re-evaluates on a fresh checkout to the verdict its committed summary states or its survey report and a committed re-evaluation record state the discrepancy and which conclusions it affects.
- [hard] REQ-02: No receipt, snapshot byte or committed summary changes except to add a missing snapshot file whose content matches the digest the receipt pins, and every such addition is recorded with its source and digest.
- [hard] REQ-03: A committed check detects a receipt whose producing snapshot omits a file the receipt pins, runs from a fresh checkout, and fails on the pre-fix state of the listed receipts.

## Notes

Surfaced while showing that a protocol acceptance-behaviour change preserves every committed verdict. Restoring files into committed evidence directories needs the repository owner's explicit approval; recording the discrepancy is the alternative.
title: Make committed receipts reproduce their verdicts on a fresh checkout
